lede: Wat Li accounts for 32 catalogued manuscripts, 4 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Phayao (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (84%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (16%). Dated witnesses run 1866–2024 CE (20 of 32 carry a date).
